2026-10-23-116.title: More work for your AI assistant
2026-10-23-116.body: Your AI assistant now does almost everything you do in Madar, with your rights. It sets up projects, works with templates and group chats, changes and deletes your posts and messages, and marks your notices read. The Admin turns on Admin work for a role with the switch "AI does Admin work". It asks you first before a delete or a change of people. A project delete stays in the screens.
